## The CPA Pipeline Crisis

The number of CPA exam candidates has declined 33% since 2016. Simultaneously, 75% of CPAs reached retirement eligibility in 2020. The result: a severe talent shortage that is reshaping the accounting profession.

### Why Young People Are Avoiding Accounting

- 150-hour requirement : Extra year of education for CPA licensure
- Compensation gap : Starting salaries lag tech and finance
- Work-life concerns : Busy season reputation
- Perception : "Boring" stereotype persists
- Alternative careers : Data science, consulting, fintech offer similar analytical work with better pay

### Competitive Compensation Response

| Role | 2024 | 2026 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Staff Accountant | $55K | $65K | +18% |
| Senior Accountant | $70K | $85K | +21% |
| Audit Manager | $95K | $115K | +21% |
| Tax Manager | $100K | $120K | +20% |
| Controller | $130K | $155K | +19% |
| CFO (mid-market) | $180K | $220K | +22% |

### Innovative Hiring Strategies

#### 1. Relax CPA Requirements

Not every accounting role needs a CPA. Consider:

- Operational accounting roles without CPA requirement
- CPA-track positions with firm-sponsored exam preparation
- International accountant pathways (credentials from other countries)

#### 2. Technology Integration

Position accounting as a technology career:

- Cloud accounting platforms (NetSuite, Sage Intacct)
- Data analytics and visualization
- RPA and process automation
- AI-powered audit tools

#### 3. Flexible Work Models

The profession's biggest change:

- Remote and hybrid work (formerly unthinkable in audit)
- Flexible scheduling during busy season
- Compressed work weeks during non-peak periods
- Mental health and wellness programs

#### 4. Pipeline Development

- High school accounting awareness programs
- Community college partnerships
- Scholarship programs with employment commitments
- "Try accounting" internship programs
- Career changer pathways from banking, finance, and data

### Alternative Talent Sources

| Source | Strengths | Development Needs |
|---|---|---|
| International accountants | Strong technical skills | US GAAP, CPA exam |
| Career changers (finance) | Analytical skills | Accounting standards |
| Bookkeepers (experienced) | Practical skills | Theory, CPA prep |
| Data analysts | Technology skills | Accounting domain |
